encoder_method_note:
The message is carried by the 18 buildings in the `skyline` group, read left to right. Each building is a path drawn from the baseline y=330 up to a top y, and its height (330 minus the top value) equals the ASCII code of one character: 114, 111, 111, 109, 32, 51, 48, 52, 32, 112, 97, 115, 115, 32, 57, 49, 56, 50. The three very short buildings (height 32) are the spaces, so the heights spell out "room 304 pass 9182"; everything else (stars, moon, windows pattern, reflection, lamps) is decorative.
